document.about: Eppendorf Multipette E3/E3x performance data sheet (2 pages). Its technical specifications are a list of fields, `Label | value` down two columns, ruled under every row and set in one face throughout, with no header row.

notes: Page 2 sets a tinted box at its foot: two lines of prose at the left, a QR code drawn as shapes at the right.

checks.issue: Read as one paragraph, the box’s two lines ended within the QR code’s reach and were typed as its label.

element.text: For more information and article numbers, visit www.eppendorf.com/E3
